visualCharacteristics.purpose: Zig-zag feature rows of an image beside text (eyebrow, heading, paragraph, CTA); swap the cell order per row to alternate the image side
visualCharacteristics.layout: Zig-zag rows: image alternating left/right with eyebrow, H2 (key words in red), paragraph and grey arrow button; generous vertical spacing.

contentPattern.description: 3 alternating image + text rows (eyebrow, H2, paragraph, CTA).
contentPattern.structure: One row per feature, 2 cells: an image-only cell and a text cell (eyebrow paragraph, H2, paragraph, CTA link). Swap the cell order on alternate rows
contentPattern.notes: CTAs are <button>s in the source with no href in cleaned.html; target URLs must be resolved during import. Red words can be authored as emphasis. Video: a media cell holding only a Brightcove player link (players.brightcove.net), optionally with a poster image, renders a click-to-play player. Detected automatically; the video option is accepted but not required.

usage.description: Zig-zag feature rows of an image beside text (eyebrow, heading, paragraph, CTA); swap the cell order per row to alternate the image side.

reuseGuidance: Use for 2-cell image/text rows. Use columns for general multi-column layouts.
